value.answer: Assuming you mean Oakville, Ontario: there's no open Costco in Oakville yet. The one on Wyecroft Rd near Burloak Dr is still under construction, with a fall 2027 opening target. The closest open warehouses are Burlington at 1225 Brant St, or South Mississauga at 3180 Laird Rd. If you're in west Oakville, Burlington is probably the closer one.
